thread:
nora (AE): Newterra procurement: they want a POC next week. Requirements: SAML SSO (IdP+SP), SCIM provisioning with delta + bulk import (~12k users), group->role RBAC mapping, tenant segmentation by DNS-verified subdomain, and delegated admin controls. Compliance: HIPAA + evidence for SOC2; BYOK/HSM mentioned as potential must. Can we triage blockers now?

 diego (SE): I can do a 30m pre-call. Quick clarifiers: do they need signed *and* encrypted assertions, and do they want SP-initiated only? Also confirm SAML session timeout override via our API.

 meera (Security): Important items from their questionnaire: 1) customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) with import & rotation logs 2) mTLS support for ACS endpoints preferred 3) 5-year audit retention for auth & provisioning events (they're strict) 4) SCIM change history (who changed what) and immutable audit trail 5) IP allowlist for admin UI and SAML endpoints 6) proof of tenant ownership via DNS TXT and org verification docs. BYOK + mTLS likely forces Private deployment — flag as blocker.

 val (Solutions): For group->role mapping and delegated admins, heres a sample SCIM mapping snippet customers can paste into Okta/Azure: ```json
{"scimMapping": {"userName": "userPrincipalName","fullName": "name.formatted","roles": "groups","tenant": "urn:custom:org:tenantId","delegatedAdmin": "extension_isDelegatedAdmin"}}```

 diego (SE): SAML metadata to share with their IdP admin: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://newterra.redwood.example/sp\">
  <SPSSODescriptor protocolSupportEnumeration=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol\">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://newterra.redwood.example/saml/acs\" index=\"1\"/>
    <NameIDFormat>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress</NameIDFormat>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

 nora (AE): Pricing question: will BYOK + 5yr retention + mTLS/IP allowlist require Dedicated/Private? They are mid-enterprise and might not commit to Reserved yet.

 diego (SE): Short answer: BYOK (HSM) + guaranteed long retention + mTLS endpoint cert pinning -> typically Private. For POC we can do hosted demo with temporary elevated controls (short-term retention waiver, temp rate-limit bump), but any production commitment with BYOK needs Private contract. I'll confirm exact thresholds with product.

 meera (Security): Also request their IdP vendor (Okta/Ping/AzureAD) and whether they plan SCIM via System for Cross-domain Identity Management v2.0. We need their SCIM provisioning cadence (near-real-time vs nightly) to size and quote bulk windows.

 val (Solutions): Example DNS TXT verification we ask them to create: ```text
redwood-tenant=newterra-7890
```  Verify with: ```bash
dig +short TXT tenant.newterra.example
# expect: "redwood-tenant=newterra-7890"
```

 diego (SE): For initial import: we can run a one-time bulk job from CSV/SCIM (12k users). If they need guaranteed throughput for ongoing delta syncs, recommend Dedicated. Also note SCIM rate-limit and backoff semantics in doc we will share.

 nora (AE): Action list: 1) @diego prepare SAML troubleshooting checklist + confirm POC-hosted delta SCIM limits 2) @val send SCIM mapping + bulk-import instructions to procurement 3) @meera mark questionnaire items that must force Private 4) I'll draft pricing stub and drop in the invite.

 meera (Security): I'll flag the must-blockers: BYOK/HSM + mTLS + 5yr retention = Private. If they accept hosted with reduced retention (90 days) and no BYOK we can proceed on Hosted for POC. Also request SOC2 report and encrypt-at-rest certs.

 env-provision-bot: Note: demo-env allocated at 2024-05-09T14:05Z for 96h. Request extension via #eng-infra if needed.

 val (Solutions): Quick sample role mapping rules we can demo: - Okta group `Newterra_Admins` -> Redwood role `org-admin` - `Newterra_Viewers` -> `read-only`. We'll include JSON examples in follow-up.

 diego (SE): Troubleshooting tips to include: check assertion timestamps (clock skew), cert thumbprint mismatch, NameID format mismatches, and SCIM bearer token validity. I'll attach a brief checklist.

 nora (AE): Scheduling: pre-call tomorrow 10am PT with their IdP admin + procurement. I'll attach the security questionnaire and a short POC plan. :white_check_mark:

 val (Solutions): I'll prepare an email pack after the pre-call containing: SAML metadata, SCIM mapping examples, bulk-import instructions, DNS TXT proof steps, and the security responses we can provide for Hosted POC. Anyone want to add items?

 meera (Security): Add statement about incident response SLA differences between Hosted POC (best-effort) and Private/Dedicated (contracted). Also add that Private supports customer-managed HSM and higher retention SLAs.

 nora (AE): Great, thanks all. Will post calendar invite and upload initial questionnaire answers for review. :rocket:
